en_title: You Need to Have Completed Crimson Desert's Main Storyline to Begin Kliff, Oongka, and Damiane's New DLC Stories
cn_title: 《红色沙漠》后日谈须先通关主线
subtitle: 各自的下一程
opus_summary: 《红色沙漠》新扩展将于10月29日推出，三位主角的后日谈须通关主线才能体验。新增开放世界内容则只需在第三章建好营地，包含探索与海上玩法，不受通关要求限制。

paragraphs.en: You need to have completed Crimson Desert’s main storyline to begin Kliff, Oongka, and Damiane’s new DLC stories, Pearl Abyss has confirmed.
paragraphs.cn: Pearl Abyss确认，玩家必须先通关《红色沙漠》的主线剧情，才能开启Kliff、Oongka和Damiane的DLC新故事。

paragraphs.en: Speaking on Dropped Frames , Pearl Abyss' Will Powers confirmed two entry points for the Charting the Unknown DLC, which launches on October 29. You’ll need to have completed the main storyline to play the first entry point, which is the epilogue story content for each of the three main characters. The second is, you need to have established the Greymane camp during Chapter 3 of the main game to be able to play the new open world content, which includes exploration, naval gameplay, and pretty much everything that is not the new character-specific story DLC.
paragraphs.cn: Pearl Abyss的Will Powers在《Dropped Frames》节目中确认，10月29日推出的DLC《Charting the Unknown》有两种开启条件。第一类是三位主角各自的后日谈剧情，玩家需要先完成主线剧情才能游玩。第二类是新增的开放世界内容，玩家只需在本篇第三章建立灰鬃营地即可体验，包括探索、海上玩法，以及除了角色专属新剧情之外的几乎所有新增内容。

paragraphs.en: “There's storylines for the three characters,” Powers explained. “Damiane, Oongka, and Kliff, you didn't really get to explore a lot of their backstory, a lot of their motivations during the main game. Now, it's effectively an epilogue for all three characters. What are they doing after? They're not necessarily together anymore and traveling together. After all of this, what is Oongka going to do in the world? What is Damiane going to do in the world? What is Kliff going to do in the world? So there are those storylines, which are really cool and unique in and of themselves.
paragraphs.cn: Powers解释道：「三位角色都有各自的故事线。在本篇中，玩家其实没有机会深入了解Damiane、Oongka和Kliff的许多背景故事与行动动机。这次的内容实际上就是三人的后日谈。他们之后会做些什么？他们未必还会待在一起、结伴旅行。经历这一切后，Oongka会在这个世界做些什么？Damiane会做些什么？Kliff又会做些什么？所以我们准备了这些故事线，每条故事线本身都很精彩，也各有特色。」

paragraphs.en: “But then there's also this storyline and this quest line around this new area of the map that you can play though.”
paragraphs.cn: 「不过，围绕地图上的这片新区域，也有故事线和任务线可供玩家体验。」

paragraphs.en: While completing the main Crimson Desert storyline is no mean feat (it’s a massive game that many are still soldiering through even now!), it makes sense that any epilogue story DLC would have to have this requirement rather than be baked into the main campaign to avoid spoilers.
paragraphs.cn: 通关《红色沙漠》的主线并非易事（这款游戏体量庞大，许多玩家直到现在还在奋战！）。不过，为了避免剧透，后日谈剧情DLC要求玩家先通关，而不是将内容融入主线流程，也合乎情理。

paragraphs.en: Indeed, Powers made this point on the show. “It would ruin the story for people that are focused on that stuff,” he said. “If you want open world content, if you want to be able to access all that stuff, you can do it very early in the game. If you want story focused content, then you've probably already beaten the story. So you'll be able to continue along that.”
paragraphs.cn: Powers也确实在节目中提到了这一点。他说：「那样会破坏注重剧情的玩家的故事体验。如果你想玩开放世界内容，想体验那些东西，在游戏很早的阶段就可以。如果你想玩以剧情为主的内容，那你很可能已经通关了故事，接下来就能继续体验后续剧情。」

paragraphs.en: Still, it's worth noting that not that many have actually completed Crimson Desert's main story, in percentage terms at least. According to official Steam achievements data, just 10.8% of all players have unlocked the Expert Storyteller achievement, which is awarded for completing all main quests. Perhaps we shouldn't be surprised by the data here; Crimson Desert is a game packed with hundreds, if not thousands of hours of content, and it is easy to get sidetracked. Personally, I've logged nearly 70 hours in Crimson Desert on Steam, but am nowhere near finishing the main story. I'm not sure I ever will.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，值得注意的是，真正完成《红色沙漠》主线的玩家并不多，至少从比例来看是如此。Steam官方成就数据显示，只有10.8%的玩家解锁了完成全部主线任务才能获得的「Expert Storyteller」成就。或许这个数字并不值得惊讶：《红色沙漠》的内容即便没有上千小时，也有数百小时，玩家很容易就会转去做别的事情。就我自己而言，我在Steam上已经玩了近70小时，却还远未通关主线。我甚至不确定自己最终能否通关。

paragraphs.en: Charting the Unknown adds new stories, ocean exploration, romance, business management and expanded housing to an already feature-packed Pywel. We have everything you need to know about the major additions in a Crimson Desert Charting the Unknown DLC features roundup .
paragraphs.cn: 《Charting the Unknown》将为本就玩法丰富的帕卫尔大陆带来新故事、海洋探索、恋爱、商业经营，以及进一步扩充的住房内容。
